shared_elements: human form (rendered figures in A, the statue's own body in B)
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in shallow relief and both feature a prominent circular disc set within sweeping curved bands, in A the rayed disc under an arched frame, in B the ring motif at the centre of the carved back with arcs below it. The biggest difference is format and density: A is a flat rectangular wall panel crowded with figures and dense inscription registers, while B is a freestanding three-dimensional sculpted block whose back bears only a few sparse, deeply cut abstract motifs.
